s.en: show links or modify link properties

syn: tipc link set ⏎ [ { priority PRIORITY | tolerance TOLERANCE | window WINDOW } link LINK ] | ⏎ [ { broadcast [ BROADCAST | REPLICAST | AUTOSELECT [ ratio SIZE ] ] } ] ⏎ tipc link get ⏎ [ { priority | tolerance | window } link LINK ] | ⏎ [ { broadcast } ]

o.en: Show help about last valid command. For example tipc link --help will show link help and tipc --help will show general help. The position of the option in the string is irrelevant.
Output results in JavaScript Object Notation (JSON).
The default JSON format is compact and more efficient to parse but hard for most users to read. This flag adds indentation for readability.
